_comment: Card data, loaded by ContentDb. 'when': always | onHit | onCrit | onMiss. 'target': target | self | party | allEnemies | adjacent (no formation: a random other enemy) | random2 (2 different random enemies; on a Save card each rolls its own save). Poison (amount, rounds): damage at the start of each of the bearer's turns. Draw (count): Rare cards only. classId 'basic' = always-available actions. 'upgrade' (optional): text/effects that replace the base ones when a copy is upgraded (campfire or merchant); the card keeps its name with a '+'. WeaponDamage takes an optional 'bonus'. Class basic actions are classId 'basic' too, linked from heroes.json 'basicAction'; 'exhaust' on a basic = once per fight. 'spell': true makes an Attack roll the spell attack (spell DC - 8). 'short' labels small buttons. 'fx' picks the hit effect: slash, smash, stab, bite, arrow, bolt, fire, missile, radiant, poison (cards without one use the hero's weaponFx or their damage type). Round 11: 'uses' on a basic = times per fight (Bardic Inspiration 3). New effects: Inspire (dice, count: Inspiration dice spent automatically on a failed d20 they can turn), Smite (dice, undead: the next hit), WildShape (form, name, tempHp, dice), HuntersMark (dice), LayOnHands (pool from balance), TempHp (amount). New conditions: Outlined (attacks against have advantage), Restrained (attacks against have advantage, its attacks disadvantage), Paralyzed / Charmed (loses its next turn). BonusDamage 'if' also takes target.Hurt and creature types (target.undead).
